readerCopy.headline: People may meet you halfway.
readerCopy.body:
The email gets answered. The introduction is warmer. A room that usually feels difficult may feel less guarded. You may find it easier to ask for the meeting, join the conversation, or let people know what you are working on without feeling like you have to prove the entire case first.

Jupiter trine your Ascendant can make confidence and goodwill easier to access. Use the easier response while it is available. Let people help, make the introduction, or open the door. Just remember that a warm reception is not the same as unlimited availability. You still get to decide how much access comes after the first yes.
